title: Before you start
body: This service helps you finish the next step in your care after birth. It is not emergency care. It does not replace your care team. It is not therapy. A person at your practice reads what you send. Roles that may see your answers: your OB clinician, your care coordinator, and a referral partner if you choose. Your mood answers start as {{default_sharing}}. You can change this any time. Every time a staff member views your answers, it is recorded and you can see it. Anything you type is read by a person, not a program, by {{read_by}}. You can pause or stop check-ins from your home screen in two taps. Your named contact is {{contact_name}} at {{contact_phone}}.

title: About this demonstration
body: This is a demonstration with made-up data. Nothing you enter here is seen by any clinician. The numbers and names on screen are not real. A clinician is present or reachable during this session. If you need real help, use the card you were given, or call or text 988.

title: One answer is always shared
body: If you answer yes to the question about harming yourself, your care team will be told even if you chose nobody yet. This rule is a placeholder until the clinical owner confirms it.

title: What stays private
body: If you answer yes to the question about harming yourself, your care team will not be told if you chose nobody yet. You will see the emergency instruction and the crisis line instead. This rule is a placeholder until the clinical owner confirms it.

title: What happens to your notes
body: Anything you type is read by a person. It is also checked against a short list of emergency words when you send it. If a word matches, you see the emergency instruction and the practice gets an urgent item right away. No program answers you.

title: What happens to your notes
body: Anything you type is read by a person, not a program. No program scans your words. A nurse reads your note by the same-business-day time shown on screen. If you need help sooner, the emergency instruction and crisis line are next to every note field.

title: Is it safe to message you?
body: Is it safe for you to receive texts and emails from us on this phone? If you answer no, we send no message content. You will still see everything here in the app.

title: Who sees your mood answers
body: You decide who sees your mood answers: your OB clinician only, your clinician and coordinator, those two and a referral partner, or nobody yet. The starting choice is the most private one. You can change it any time from home.
